answer_1.quote: conversational question answering (QA) over knowledge bases (KB) has attracted broad interests. It aims to satisfy users' information needs by retrieving answers from a given knowledge graph to users' questions in a multi-turn conversational setting
answer_1.outputs: logical forms and answers in a conversational setting

answer_2.quote: When answers are composed of one or more entities, F1 score is used as the evaluation metric. When answers are a Boolean value or number, accuracy is used as the metric.
